note: Palo Alto County (IA) publishes its zoning districts only as a static PDF map (2019) and through the Schneider Beacon viewer, which offers no public queryable zoning service. The county's zoning department directs zoning map inquiries to the building department. Emmetsburg, the county seat, publishes its city zoning map only as a 2023 PDF. ArcGIS searches for Palo Alto County and Emmetsburg zoning returned no REST layers; the Iowa statewide services folder has no Palo Alto zoning layer. Other cities (Graettinger, Mallard, Ruthven, West Bend, Ayrshire) have no zoning service found.
